content.title: What happened to the ABC mobile and streaming device apps? – ABC
content.text: Please enter your birthdate Please enter your birthdate Submit Skip to Main Content SUPPORT Request Technical SupportSubmit Programming Feedback The ABC mobile and streaming device apps are no longer available. There are still plenty of ways to watch everything ABC on air, online, and on demand. Here are some great ways you can continue watching your favorite shows, specials, movies, and more: ABC.COM: Visit on your desktop or mobile device TV PROVIDER: Sign in or check with a TV provider for more ways to watch HULU: Stream full episodes next day and full seasons anytime DISNEY+: Stream content from National Geographic, Disney, Marvel, and more ABC NEWS: The latest news from across the country & around the world LOCAL NEWS: Check affiliate stations for current local news ESPN: Watch live sports with ESPN and ESPN+ Please sign in to leave a comment. Need more help? Email Email Us Phone Phone Offline Phone Phone Email us at changetoabcemail@abc.com Was this article helpful? Yes No Thank you for your feedback! How can we improve? Notice of Right to Opt Out of Sale/SharingSome US states provide residents (or their authorized agents) with the right to opt out of “targeted advertising,” “selling,” or “sharing” of personal information, as defined by applicable laws. You can move the toggle to the left and click “Submit” to opt out of such activities occurring through this digital property. If you are logged in, we may be able to associate your choice with your account and apply it to data sharing occurring through this digital property (across your browsers and devices) as well as other digital properties of The Walt Disney Family of Companies. You can confirm the status of your choice or opt out or in by clicking “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” or “Your Privacy Choices” on each property. Manage Consent PreferencesSelling, Sharing, Targeted Advertising Selling, Sharing, Targeted Advertising If you are not logged in, your opt-out will be specific to this property and device or browser. For our other digital properties, to opt out, select “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” or “Your Privacy Choices” on each. If you clear your tracking history or use another browser or device, you’ll need to opt out again.You can also submit this opt-out form, which may enable us to apply your opt-out more broadly, for example, to stop data sharing in connection with advertising intended to reach you on platforms not operated by Disney (e.g., social media platforms). You may enable online, where available, a universal tool that automatically communicates your opt-out, such as Global Privacy Control (“GPC”), which we’ll process as if you had opted out through the toggle.Even if you opt out, you may continue to see advertising, including ads that may be based on personal information processed before you opted out.
